# Perflo

> Money accounts, cards, trading, and payments for people, businesses, and AI agents.

## Docs

- [Welcome to Perflo](https://docs.perflo.ai/introduction.md): One account for money, assets, trading, cards, and payments. Built for people, businesses, and the AI agents that work for them.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.perflo.ai/quickstart.md): Open a Perflo account, verify your identity, and see your first money land, all in about ten minutes.
- [Create your account](https://docs.perflo.ai/getting-started/create-account.md): Sign up with your email in about a minute. You won't need a seed phrase, a browser extension, or any gas tokens.
- [Verify your identity](https://docs.perflo.ai/getting-started/verify-identity.md): KYC for individuals, KYB for businesses. Verification unlocks money features, usually within minutes.
- [Fund your account](https://docs.perflo.ai/getting-started/fund-your-account.md): Four ways in: bank transfer, debit or credit card, recurring bank funding, or crypto deposit, plus how long each typically takes.
- [Troubleshooting: getting started](https://docs.perflo.ai/getting-started/troubleshooting.md): Fixes for stuck verification, missing deposits, declined card top-ups, wrong-network deposits, and locked features.
- [How Perflo works](https://docs.perflo.ai/concepts/how-perflo-works.md): Self-custody, session permissions, and public venues. What Perflo can and cannot do with your money, and where the trade-offs are.
- [Guardrails](https://docs.perflo.ai/concepts/guardrails.md): Hard limits, allowlists, expiry, and a kill switch. How Perflo keeps automated money movement safe.
- [Security](https://docs.perflo.ai/reference/security.md): How your account is protected, what Perflo can and cannot do, common scams to refuse, and how to report issues.
- [Fees and limits](https://docs.perflo.ai/concepts/fees-and-limits.md): What you pay, what Perflo sponsors, which costs come from venues, and what determines your limits.
- [Cash](https://docs.perflo.ai/money/cash.md): Your dollar balance: what it actually is, what protects it, and everything it can do.
- [Earn](https://docs.perflo.ai/money/earn.md): Earn interest on cash you're not using through audited public lending vaults. Rates vary, and you can withdraw anytime.
- [Futures](https://docs.perflo.ai/trading/futures.md): Trade crypto, US stocks, commodities, FX, and indices around the clock on a public derivatives order book.
- [Predictions](https://docs.perflo.ai/trading/predictions.md): Take positions on real-world events on Polymarket. Buy YES or NO, exit early, redeem winners.
- [Virtual cards](https://docs.perflo.ai/cards-banking/virtual-cards.md): Create virtual Mastercards funded from your balance. For you, your business, and your agents.
- [Bank accounts](https://docs.perflo.ai/cards-banking/bank-accounts.md): Virtual bank accounts with local details in ten currencies. First-party and third-party pay-ins.
- [Payouts and transfers](https://docs.perflo.ai/cards-banking/payouts-and-transfers.md): Send money to bank accounts in 45+ currencies, transfer to saved recipients, and gift assets.
- [Troubleshooting: cards and payouts](https://docs.perflo.ai/cards-banking/troubleshooting.md): Fixes for declined card payments, delayed payouts, paused bank withdrawals, rejected transfers, and frozen cards.
- [AI agents on Perflo](https://docs.perflo.ai/agents/overview.md): Give an AI agent real financial capability with limits you control. This is what Perflo is built for.
- [Connect an agent](https://docs.perflo.ai/agents/connect.md): Add Perflo to Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI app in about five minutes, and connect coding agents like Claude Code.
- [Agent spending and budgets](https://docs.perflo.ai/agents/spending-and-budgets.md): How agents pay per call, how budgets with hard caps work, statements, and the kill switch.
- [The service marketplace](https://docs.perflo.ai/agents/services.md): A catalog of verified pay-per-call services your agent can buy from within your budget: search, data, media, email, and more.
- [Agent security](https://docs.perflo.ai/agents/security.md): How agent access actually works end to end, what can go wrong, and what limits the damage in every case.
- [Errors and denials](https://docs.perflo.ai/agents/errors-and-denials.md): Every machine-readable code an agent can receive when Perflo refuses a request, what each one means, and what fixes it.
- [Troubleshooting: agents](https://docs.perflo.ai/agents/troubleshooting.md): Fixes for connector setup failures, sign-in loops, unexpected denials, agents stopping mid-task, and recovering after the kill switch.
- [Assets (Ethereum accounts)](https://docs.perflo.ai/money/assets.md): Buying, holding, automating, and gifting assets on Ethereum accounts. Not available on new accounts.
- [Borrow (Ethereum accounts)](https://docs.perflo.ai/money/borrow.md): Borrowing dollars against assets on Ethereum accounts. Not available on new accounts.
- [FAQ](https://docs.perflo.ai/reference/faq.md): Straight answers to the most common questions about custody, safety, agents, fees, and availability.
- [Changelog](https://docs.perflo.ai/changelog.md): Product and documentation changes, newest first, with notice periods for anything that breaks.
- [Supported currencies and assets](https://docs.perflo.ai/reference/supported-currencies.md): Where you can hold local bank accounts, where you can collect and pay out, and the stablecoins and crypto assets you can hold.
- [Networks and contracts](https://docs.perflo.ai/reference/networks-and-contracts.md): The chains, tokens, and contract addresses behind your Perflo balance. Verify everything yourself.
- [Perflo Finance API](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/overview.md): Connect a Perflo account and integrate money movement, mandates, cards, and live service purchases through one API.
- [Authorize a customer device](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/get-started/authorize-device.md): Run the Perflo device flow, obtain a customer token, refresh it safely, and revoke the device when it is no longer needed.
- [Connect a Perflo login](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/get-started/connect-perflo.md): Link the gateway's dedicated device to the authenticated customer's Perflo account and verify capabilities.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/get-started/quickstart.md): Verify the customer identity, check the Perflo connection, and read the first account data.
- [Use the TypeScript SDK](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/get-started/typescript-sdk.md): Install the Perflo TypeScript SDK preview, configure a bearer token, and make typed API calls.
- [Test the live TypeScript SDK](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/get-started/live-api-exercise.md): Connect a customer account and exercise the production Perflo Finance API with guarded reads, sessions, webhooks, quotes, and mutations.
- [Authentication and token lifecycle](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/concepts/authentication.md): Use customer Perflo tokens, gateway device credentials, and mandate-scoped pairing tokens without exposing financial authority.
- [Identity model](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/concepts/identity.md): Understand customer Perflo tokens and mandate-scoped pairing tokens.
- [Confirmation and idempotency](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/concepts/confirmation-idempotency.md): Bind sensitive customer actions to one-use intents and retry financial mutations without creating duplicate writes.
- [Operations and errors](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/concepts/operations-errors.md): Track asynchronous mutations, handle hosted approval, replay idempotently, and reconcile uncertain outcomes from problem documents.
- [Partner wallet API](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/partner-wallets/overview.md): Provision a Perflo wallet for an existing Privy user and request one text-message signature at a time.
- [Authenticate partner wallet requests](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/partner-wallets/authentication.md): Bind each backend request to your partner registration, exact JSON body, and signed-in Privy user.
- [Provision a partner wallet](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/partner-wallets/provisioning.md): Prove control of an existing embedded wallet and permanently bind the Privy user to a fresh Perflo wallet.
- [Sign a message with a partner wallet](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/partner-wallets/sign-messages.md): Bind one personal_sign message to a single-use handoff and verify the Perflo wallet's returned signature.
- [Partner wallet endpoint reference](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/partner-wallets/reference.md): Exact requests, responses, errors, limits, and single-use nonce behavior for the partner wallet API.
- [Accounts, KYC, and activity](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/guides/accounts-kyc.md): Check onboarding readiness, guide customer verification, and read balances, display currency, and account activity.
- [Beneficiaries and transfers](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/guides/beneficiaries-transfers.md): Build a payout form, create a beneficiary, quote a transfer, complete browser approval, and reconcile the operation.
- [Manage cards and card funding](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/guides/cards.md): Read the card account, fund and withdraw from it, issue and relabel cards, manage their lifecycle, and inspect activity.
- [Spending funds](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/guides/spending.md): Read held spending funds and withdraw a specified USD amount or all withdrawable funds safely.
- [Agent mandates and pairing](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/guides/agent-mandates.md): Create bounded authority, complete approval, pair one agent, execute payments, and revoke access.
- [Service purchases](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/guides/service-purchases.md): Discover, quote, buy, and reconcile a live service as a customer or mandate-bound agent.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/guides/webhooks.md): Register a customer callback, verify signed operation events, handle duplicates and reordering, and recover through operation reads.
- [TypeScript SDK reference](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/reference/typescript-sdk.md): Look up the Perflo TypeScript client, generated operations and types, polling helpers, transport methods, and recovery helpers.
- [Currencies and money](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/reference/currencies.md): Use the supported currencies and exact decimal money objects.
- [Glossary](https://docs.perflo.ai/developers/reference/glossary.md): Define the identity, device, operation, mandate, and grant terms used by Perflo Finance API.
- [Poll Perflo device authentication](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/perflo-device-tokens/poll-perflo-device-authentication.md): Relays a Perflo device poll with both per-address and per-sid rate limits. The session ID is the capability: treat it as a short-lived bearer secret.
- [Start Perflo device authentication](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/perflo-device-tokens/start-perflo-device-authentication.md): Relays the public Perflo CLI device-start request and response without modification.
- [List the customer's Perflo devices](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/perflo-device-tokens/list-the-customers-perflo-devices.md): Relays the authenticated device list and marks the device linked here.
- [Poll a Perflo CLI signing approval](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/perflo-device-tokens/poll-a-perflo-cli-signing-approval.md): Relays a Perflo sign poll with both per-address and per-sid rate limits. The session ID is the capability: treat it as a short-lived bearer secret.
- [Start a Perflo CLI signing approval](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/perflo-device-tokens/start-a-perflo-cli-signing-approval.md): Relays the authenticated Perflo CLI sign-start request and response without modification. None of the signing payload is stored.
- [Refresh a Perflo access token](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/perflo-device-tokens/refresh-a-perflo-access-token.md): Relays the public Perflo CLI token-refresh request and response. The refresh token can rotate, so the exchange is not idempotent: after a lost or ambiguous response, run a new device authorization instead of retrying the old refresh token.
- [Revoke a Perflo token](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/perflo-device-tokens/revoke-a-perflo-token.md): Relays the authenticated Perflo CLI token-revocation request and response.
- [List deposit accounts](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/accounts/list-deposit-accounts.md): Lists the customer's fiat deposit accounts with the coordinates for funding them. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. Rows that are not deposit accounts are omitted. A deposit-routing account is a transfer-routing record rather than a stored-value account, so its null balances are a s…
- [Read the display currency and rate](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/accounts/read-the-display-currency-and-rate.md): Reads the customer's Perflo display currency and the conversion rate from the base currency. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. A null body means amounts already read in the display currency and no conversion applies. The rate is an indicative display aid rather than an executable qu…
- [List account activity](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/activity/list-account-activity.md): Lists a customer-wide activity projection merged from two sources of movement, deduplicated, ordered newest first and truncated to limit. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. The projection is not a per-account ledger: an entry is not attributable to one account.
- [Refresh a paired agent token](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/refresh-a-paired-agent-token.md): Re-stamps the pairing's token issue time and returns the same opaque pfa_ token. The token is never rotated, so a lost refresh response leaves the existing value usable.
- [Redeem a connect code](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/redeem-a-connect-code.md): Presents a short-lived code as the authorization to pair an agent to its mandate. A successful redemption consumes the code and returns the new opaque pfa_ bearer token once. The self-asserted agent name is always published as unverified.
- [List mandates](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/list-mandates.md): Lists the customer's mandates. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. The list covers authority created and approved as a mandate; an automatic-payment grant made directly on the Perflo account is published by GET /v1/mandates/beneficiary-grants instead. A beneficiary mandate's remaining…
- [Create a mandate](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/create-a-mandate.md): Records a mandate, the bounded payment authority this customer delegates through an agent pairing or rule, and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. Ev…
- [List beneficiary grants](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/list-beneficiary-grants.md): Lists the automatic-payment authority made directly on the Perflo account rather than as a mandate. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. A grant can be revoked with POST /v1/mandates/beneficiary-grants/{grant_id}/revoke, or in the Perflo app. No reservation ledger is kept against it an…
- [Spend a beneficiary grant](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/spend-a-beneficiary-grant.md): Makes one payment against automatic-payment authority that already exists on the customer's Perflo account rather than as a mandate, and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. The grant is named by the identifier GET /v1/mandates/beneficiary-grants publishes. Admits a customer token carrying…
- [Revoke a beneficiary grant](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/revoke-a-beneficiary-grant.md): Revokes one automatic-payment grant made directly on the customer's Perflo account and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. The grant is named by the identifier GET /v1/mandates/beneficiary-grants publishes, and only a grant that route lists can be revoked here; a mandate's own grant is re…
- [Revoke every agent's authority](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/revoke-every-agents-authority.md): Stops every agent's authority on the account in one call. Every active pairing is revoked immediately, and one mandate revocation opens for each mandate that still holds authority: a service-purchase mandate becomes revoked in the same transaction, and a beneficiary-payment mandate moves to revocati…
- [Read a mandate](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/read-a-mandate.md): Returns one mandate owned by the customer. A service-purchase mandate and its remaining rolling allowance are read entirely from local state. A grant-backed beneficiary mandate retains the reconciliation performed by the list route, and its remaining allowance counts only payments made under the man…
- [Mint a connect code](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/mint-a-connect-code.md): Mints a short-lived, single-use connect code for an active service-purchase or beneficiary-payment mandate. Presenting the code is the authorization to create one pairing, so transfer it out of band and treat it as a credential. It expires in ten minutes, and beneficiary authority must already exist…
- [Execute a mandate payment](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/execute-a-mandate-payment.md): Makes one payment under an existing mandate and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Two caller classes are admitted: the customer who owns the mandate, carrying a fresh iat and a one-use confirmation naming this mandate and amount, or an agent token carrying the mandates:execute scope who…
- [Revoke an agent pairing](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/revoke-an-agent-pairing.md): Revokes one customer-owned pairing and cancels its unsent mandate executions. The pairing remains visible in the mandate audit history.
- [Revoke a mandate](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/mandates/revoke-a-mandate.md): Revokes one of the customer's mandates and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. Revocation is a transition rather than a deletion: the mandate record…
- [List beneficiaries](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/beneficiaries/list-beneficiaries.md): Lists the beneficiaries this customer can send to. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. Every field is emitted on every row, so a null is the beneficiary's own absence of a value rather than an omission by this read.
- [Create a beneficiary](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/beneficiaries/create-a-beneficiary.md): Records a beneficiary creation and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token without requiring a fresh iat: this is the one financial mutation where that is a deliberate choice rather than an omission. The Idempotency-Key header binds for at least the replay window publi…
- [List beneficiary address countries](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/beneficiaries/list-beneficiary-address-countries.md): Lists the countries accepted in beneficiary address fields. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. This list is independent from residence and payout-destination countries.
- [Find a beneficiary by nickname](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/beneficiaries/find-a-beneficiary-by-nickname.md): Returns the customer's beneficiary carrying the exact private label. Admits a customer token, answers synchronously, and answers 404 when no current beneficiary can be joined to that label.
- [List payout countries](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/beneficiaries/list-payout-countries.md): Lists the payout countries currently accepted for new beneficiaries. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously.
- [List payout schemas](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/beneficiaries/list-payout-schemas.md): Lists the payout forms available for one ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country, each naming the inputs POST /v1/beneficiaries must answer. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. A null purpose_codes means none is declared, and that null is advisory; a non-empty list is authoritative, and POST /v1/b…
- [Read a beneficiary](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/beneficiaries/read-a-beneficiary.md): Returns one of the customer's beneficiaries. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously.
- [Relabel a beneficiary](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/beneficiaries/relabel-a-beneficiary.md): Changes or clears the customer's private label and returns the updated beneficiary. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. A null or blank nickname clears the label. Answers 409 when another beneficiary already carries the requested label.
- [Read the card account](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/read-the-card-account.md): Reads the customer's card-account profile, verification state, current deposit balance and lifetime deposited total. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously.
- [Read the card funding address](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/read-the-card-funding-address.md): Reads the customer's card-account funding address, accepted assets and minimum amount. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. An optional card identifier scopes the destination to that card. Either way, the response's own card identifier names the card the destination belongs to.
- [List card-account deposits](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/list-card-account-deposits.md): Lists the customer's card-account deposits and total credited amount. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. An optional card identifier scopes the result to that card. Either way, the response's own card identifier names the card the deposits and total belong to.
- [Read card verification](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/read-card-verification.md): Reads the customer's normalized card-verification status, its stated value and whether a card can be issued. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously.
- [Start card verification](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/start-card-verification.md): Starts a hosted card-verification session and answers with the normalized status, the verification token, the applicant identifier and the action to open. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously.
- [List card-account withdrawals](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/list-card-account-withdrawals.md): Lists the customer's card-account withdrawals. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. An optional card identifier scopes the result to that card.
- [Withdraw card-account funds](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/withdraw-card-account-funds.md): Records an idempotent card-account withdrawal and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. - [List cards](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/list-cards.md): Lists the customer's cards. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. A card with a local write in flight keeps its in-flight status rather than being overwritten by a stale read.
- [Create a card](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/create-a-card.md): Records a card creation and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. - [Read a card](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/read-a-card.md): Reads one of the customer's cards by its card identifier. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. A card with a write in flight answers from its stored state so a read cannot overwrite that state.
- [Change a card label](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/change-a-card-label.md): Changes or clears the customer's private label for one card. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. Null or a blank value clears the label.
- [Close a card](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/close-a-card.md): Records a close on one of the customer's cards and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Closing a card is irreversible. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. The card takes close_pending w…
- [Freeze a card](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/freeze-a-card.md): Records a freeze on one of the customer's cards and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. The card takes freeze_pending while the write is submitted; a…
- [Start a card reveal session](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/start-a-card-reveal-session.md): Creates the hosted hand-off that shows the customer their own card details. Admits a customer token with a fresh iat and a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action. Answers synchronously with only a redirect on the trusted Perflo application origin, and records no operation…
- [List card transactions](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/list-card-transactions.md): Lists one card's ledger entries. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. Paging is one-based and page_size is capped at 100. An entry amount is signed, a debit negative and a credit positive, and its fee is carried separately as a non-negative amount.
- [Unfreeze a card](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/cards/unfreeze-a-card.md): Records an unfreeze on one of the customer's cards and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. The card takes unfreeze_pending while the write is submitt…
- [Create a confirmation intent](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/identity/create-a-confirmation-intent.md): Creates the one-use confirmation that a sensitive mutation later spends through the Confirmation-Intent-ID header, bound to the normalized payload of the named action. Admits a customer token with a fresh iat and answers synchronously. The intent expires ten minutes after creation.
- [Read the caller's verified identity](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/identity/read-the-callers-verified-identity.md): Returns the identity derived from the caller's verified Perflo or pairing bearer token, plus the minimum idempotency replay guarantee.
- [Read sign-in branding](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/identity/read-sign-in-branding.md): Returns the application name and mark the sign-in surface renders before anyone has authenticated. Takes no credential and makes no remote read.
- [Read verification status](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/kyc/read-verification-status.md): Returns the normalized identity-verification status, which this route is the single source of. - [Start a verification session](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/kyc/start-a-verification-session.md): Admits a customer token and answers synchronously with the hosted identity-verification hand-off: the verification page Perflo states for this customer or, when none is stated, the verification page on the configured Perflo application origin, recording no operation. - [Read onboarding state](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/onboarding/read-onboarding-state.md): Returns the single who-am-I-and-what-can-I-do view: the local customer record, the Perflo link state, the linked account identifier in full, and one capability boolean per surface. - [Start a Perflo connection](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/onboarding/start-a-perflo-connection.md): Starts the device link between this customer and their Perflo account. Admits a customer token with a fresh iat. Answers synchronously with a hosted connect action on the trusted Perflo application origin for the browser to open, and records no operation. Advance the link with POST /v1/perflo-connec…
- [Remove the Perflo connection](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/onboarding/remove-the-perflo-connection.md): Removes the customer's Perflo link and revokes the paired device on a best-effort basis. Admits a customer token with a fresh iat and answers 204 with no body. The removal erases the stored credential but keeps the account authority: mandates, agent pairings, beneficiaries, cards, quotes, and webhoo…
- [Advance the Perflo connection](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/onboarding/advance-the-perflo-connection.md): Advances the pending Perflo device link and returns its current state. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. The route takes no idempotency key and can be repeated while the link remains pending. Completion retires the one-time link session, so after a lost or ambiguous response the cli…
- [List operations](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/operations/list-operations.md): Lists the customer's own operations, unsettled work first and then newest first, truncated to limit. A card-account withdrawal rests at submitted and ranks with the settled work, because the card-account withdrawal list carries what happens to it next. Admits a customer token and answers synchronous…
- [Read an operation](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/operations/read-an-operation.md): Returns one operation's current state. Two caller classes are admitted: the customer who owns the operation, or an agent token that carries the mandates:read, purchases:read, or purchases:execute scope and whose subject and client identifier both match the actor recorded on the operation. Any other…
- [Poll an operation approval](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/operations/poll-an-operation-approval.md): Reconciles a browser approval for one operation into local state and returns the operation. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously. The route is safe to repeat by design and therefore takes no idempotency key.
- [Resolve a stuck operation approval](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/operations/resolve-a-stuck-operation-approval.md): Settles one browser approval that could not be reconciled automatically and returns the operation. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat and an Idempotency-Key. The body attests what Perflo did: grant_created finds the one new grant that still matches the stored approval exactly, or optionall…
- [Price a service purchase](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/services/price-a-service-purchase.md): Records a five-minute observation of a catalogued service or exact endpoint. An agent names its service-purchase authority in the mandate_id query parameter. The quote is required for endpoint purchases and never guarantees the price.
- [List service purchases](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/services/list-service-purchases.md): Lists the customer's service purchases, newest first. Admits a customer token and answers synchronously from local state. Filter to one mandate's purchases with mandate_id.
- [Buy a service](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/services/buy-a-service.md): Persists the operation before submission. Customer calls require fresh step-up and a one-use confirmation; agent calls require purchases:execute and an active service-purchase mandate bound to the pairing. Agents never override a confirmation threshold. A customer threshold retry must name one prior…
- [Read a service purchase](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/services/read-a-service-purchase.md): Returns a customer's purchase or the exact purchase created by the calling agent client. This read does not require the originating mandate to remain active.
- [Find service capabilities](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/services/find-service-capabilities.md): Finds normalized capabilities matching a query. Agent calls require services:read and a mandate_id query parameter naming current service-purchase authority.
- [List purchasable services](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/services/list-purchasable-services.md): Lists customer-safe service metadata. Agent calls require services:read and a mandate_id query parameter naming the active service-purchase mandate bound to that pairing and the current Perflo connection.
- [Read a purchasable service](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/services/read-a-purchasable-service.md): Returns one service and its input schema without exposing endpoint or settlement terms. Agent calls require a mandate_id query parameter naming current service-purchase authority.
- [Create a transfer quote](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/transfers/create-a-transfer-quote.md): Creates an indicative estimate for a transfer to one beneficiary. Admits a customer token, answers synchronously, and records no operation. A quote is never executable on its own: POST /v1/transfers spends it, and it carries a confirm_by deadline after which it is refused rather than repriced. Answe…
- [Send a transfer](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/transfers/send-a-transfer.md): Records the one customer-instructed money movement offered here and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. The beneficiary and every amount come from th…
- [Read the spending account](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/spending/read-the-spending-account.md): Returns held funds, promotional credit and owed balance for the signed-in customer. Agent tokens are refused.
- [Withdraw held spending funds](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/spending/withdraw-held-spending-funds.md): Persists an idempotent customer operation before asking Perflo to withdraw a specified amount or every held fund. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. The Idempotency-Key header binds for at least…
- [Read a spending withdrawal](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/spending/read-a-spending-withdrawal.md): Returns the signed-in customer's durable withdrawal status and the settled amount once Perflo reports it.
- [List webhook subscriptions](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/webhooks/list-webhook-subscriptions.md): Lists the authenticated customer's active webhook subscriptions without secrets.
- [Create a webhook subscription](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/webhooks/create-a-webhook-subscription.md): Registers a public HTTPS callback and returns its signing secret once.
- [Delete a webhook subscription](https://docs.perflo.ai/api-reference/webhooks/delete-a-webhook-subscription.md): Marks a customer-owned webhook subscription revoked. A delivery checked after revocation is dead-lettered without an outbound request, but a worker that already passed the revocation check can still send one request after the 204 response.
